visual_review.notes: Accepted after upper-fork-only fit repair: widened cheeks/bridge, enlarged intentional bearing bores, lowered bridge floor and shortened only upper neck. Preserved lower column/base/bolts and existing 1024 paint. Neutral actual head fixture passed with 17.5mm bridge/neck clearance and conservative 2.46mm radial clearance; no promise of pitch animation clearance. No operator, rig or animation.
